plan: Given my private value of $10, I aim to bid strategically to maximize profit. My bid should be slightly above the expected third-highest bid to win without overpaying. Assuming others bid close to their values, a bid of $5.0 optimizes my chances of winning while ensuring profit if the third-highest bid is lower. This minimizes potential losses and maximizes potential gains, considering the risk-neutral stance and the single-round nature of the game.

Given my private value of $6, my goal is to maximize profit by winning the auction at a cost lower than my value. Since this is the only round, I will bid conservatively to avoid overbidding. I will bid slightly above half my value to increase my chances of winning without risking a loss. I will bid $3.5 to ensure I have a chance to win if others bid low, while keeping my potential loss minimal if I win.

Given my private value of $4, I should bid conservatively to avoid losses. Since my value is low, I will bid below my value to ensure I don't pay more than the item is worth to me. Bidding $3.5 allows me to potentially win if others bid lower, but minimizes risk of overpaying.
